mapper.select: SELECT c.CATEGORY_ID AS categoryId, c.CATEGORY_CODE AS categoryCode, c.CATEGORY_NAME AS categoryName, c.DESCRIPTION AS description, CASE WHEN mpc.MEMBER_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS selected FROM CATEGORY c LEFT JOIN MEMBER_PREF_CATEGORY mpc ON c.CATEGORY_ID = mpc.CATEGORY_ID AND mpc.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} WHERE c.ACTIVE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY c.SORT_ORDER ASC, c.CATEGORY_ID ASC

SELECT t.TAG_ID AS tagId, t.TAG_NAME AS tagName, t.TAG_GROUP AS tagGroup, CASE WHEN mpt.MEMBER_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS selected FROM TAG t LEFT JOIN MEMBER_PREF_TAG mpt ON t.TAG_ID = mpt.TAG_ID AND mpt.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} WHERE t.ACTIVE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY t.TAG_ID ASC
mapper.insert:
INSERT ALL
INTO MEMBER_PREF_CATEGORY (MEMBER_ID, CATEGORY_ID, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{categoryId}, SYSTIMESTAMP)
SELECT * FROM DUAL

INSERT ALL
INTO MEMBER_PREF_TAG (MEMBER_ID, TAG_ID, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{tagId}, SYSTIMESTAMP)
SELECT * FROM DUAL
